compiled_state.title: Add quarterly subcommand to calibration-report.sh reusing monthly aggregation logic
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-2: calibration-report.sh quarterly produces a rollup comment on calibration-program-health for the quarterly period using the same aggregation logic

## Implementation
Add a `quarterly` case to the subcommand dispatcher in plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh. The quarterly subcommand:
- Resolves the target quarter (current quarter in UTC using shared CALIBRATION_TZ constant; `--period YYYY-Q[1-4]` override).
- Refactors aggregation into a shared function `aggregate_bugs_by_channel` (if not already done) so both monthly and quarterly call the same code path.
- Posts rollup comment with marker `<!-- calibration-rollup: period=YYYY-Q1 kind=quarterly -->`.
- Supports `--dry-run` and `--fixture <path>` flags consistent with monthly.
- Inherits idempotency from task-2's comment-marker check (quarterly markers have `kind=quarterly` so they do not collide with monthly markers).
- Rejects invalid period format (e.g., Q5, non-numeric) with non-zero exit.

Extend tests/scripts/test-calibration-report.sh with quarterly correctness test asserting: (a) channel counts match fixture distribution, (b) marker contains `kind=quarterly` and `YYYY-Q[1-4]`, (c) monthly and quarterly markers for overlapping windows do NOT collide.

## TDD Test Spec
Given: synthetic fixture tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs/ with known detected_by distribution
When: calibration-report.sh quarterly --fixture tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs --dry-run --period 2026-Q2 is invoked
Then: emitted rollup contains exact channel counts matching fixture AND begins with '<!-- calibration-rollup: period=2026-Q2 kind=quarterly -->' AND monthly+quarterly markers for the same calendar window are distinct strings

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Quarterly subcommand exists in dispatcher
  Verify: grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*quarterly\)' plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh
- [ ] Quarterly --dry-run rollup output contains the quarterly comment-marker (dd-2)
  Verify: plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh quarterly --fixture tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs --dry-run --period 2026-Q2 | grep -q '<!-- calibration-rollup: period=2026-Q2 kind=quarterly -->'
- [ ] Shared aggregation function is invoked by both monthly and quarterly
  Verify: grep -cE '(aggregate_bugs_by_channel|aggregate_by_channel)' plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh | awk '{exit ($1 < 2)}'
- [ ] Quarterly subcommand rejects invalid period format Q5 (non-zero exit)
  Verify: ! plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh quarterly --fixture tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs --dry-run --period 2026-Q5 2>/dev/null
- [ ] Monthly and quarterly markers for overlapping calendar window are distinct strings
  Verify: m=$(plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh monthly --fixture tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs --dry-run --period 2026-04 | grep -oE '<!--[^>]*-->') && q=$(plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh quarterly --fixture tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs --dry-run --period 2026-Q2 | grep -oE '<!--[^>]*-->') && [ "$m" != "$q" ]
- [ ] Fixture-driven quarterly correctness test passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-calibration-report.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

comments.body: AC amendment: Quarterly refactor must preserve monthly subcommand behavior and idempotency marker format. Require: (a) all existing monthly tests from task-1 and task-2 pass unmodified after refactor, (b) the idempotency HTML-comment marker format from task-2 is reused (not redefined) for quarterly — only kind= changes (kind=quarterly), (c) monthly and quarterly markers must use distinct period discriminators so they cannot collide on the tracking ticket. Taxonomy: cross_task_interference.
